question: Should five consecutive malformed paired-node audio payloads close the active Google Meet realtime or agent bridge under the existing input-error cutoff?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish the behavior, but whether repeated protocol-invalid input should terminate live meeting audio is an owner-level availability policy choice.

options.title: Approve the existing cutoff
options.body: Treat malformed payloads like other consecutive input failures and close the bridge after five errors.

options.title: Separate malformed accounting
options.body: Reject malformed chunks but track them separately so they do not consume the transient input-failure cutoff.

recommendation.title: Approve the existing cutoff
recommendation.body: Treat malformed payloads like other consecutive input failures and close the bridge after five errors.

likelyOwner.reason: He directly engaged with this PR and is connected to recent Google Meet runtime history.
